candidates.change_summary: Remove the `_ownerOf[id] = to;` update so ownership never changes on transferFrom.
Set `_ownerOf[id] = from;` instead of `to`, leaving ownership with the previous owner.
Remove the `_ownerOf[id] = to;` assignment in _mint so minted tokens never have an owner recorded.
Delete the `_balanceOf[from]--;` statement so the sender's balance is no longer decremented.
Replace `_balanceOf[to]++;` with `_balanceOf[to]--;` so the recipient's balance is decremented instead of incremented.
Replace `_balanceOf[from]--;` with `_balanceOf[to]--;` so both decrements hit the recipient's balance instead of decrementing the sender.
